cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallConsole
cc:Work.dc:description:
Outset and angled plate to mount stuff to
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallConsole --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --sx 120:80 --h 200 --walltype 'french cleat' --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallConsole --sx --h --walltype --reference --labels
